The '''father''' of [[Komad Fortuna]] was known to have gained fame by killing a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]]. His son killed a much larger krayt dragon with help from [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and succeeded his father, thus earning him and Revan respect from fellow hunter [[Dorak Quinn]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic" />
